minimalDomAxContract.contentShortening: Long Royal Mail menu, product, search, article, footer, analytics, iframes, and consent content was replaced with short neutral labels. This is safe because the disputed behavior depends on role/name/state/list position/IDREF/hidden descendant contracts, not long text, wrapping, punctuation, or OCR.

omittedContext.omission: Login/Register, search, send-an-item, hero, cards, article body, consent, iframes, analytics, and decorative SVGs
omittedContext.whySafe: They are after the disputed header packet or hidden/decorative and do not contribute to the button names, region names, expanded state, control relationships, list position, or empty-region status.
A short footer negative control was retained only to prove this C.5 is not a footer/list-position promotion target.
